name: 66086 · Tonganoxie, KS
findings: ZIP 66086 (Tonganoxie) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66086 (Tonganoxie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 66086 (Tonganoxie) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
